note_ne: DHM मौसम पूर्वानुमान महाशाखाको साइट dhm.gov.np/mfd खुल्यो; मंसिर १० बिहान ८ बजे जारी ५ दिने मौसम चेतावनी (१२४५३) सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो हो। नक्साका रङ १२४५१ बाट बदलिएका छैनन्। नक्सा पढियो: मंसिर १० देखि मंसिर १४ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर हरियो; रातो, सुन्तला वा पहेँलो चेतावनी छैन। नदीको तह यस पटक पुनः जाँचिएको छैन; पछिल्लो अवस्था नदी पृष्ठमा हेर्नुहोस्।
note_en: DHM's forecasting site dhm.gov.np/mfd loaded; the 5-day weather warning issued at 8 AM Mangsir 10 (12453) is the latest. Map colours are unchanged from 12451. Maps read: green across the country on all five days, Mangsir 10 to Mangsir 14; no red, orange or yellow. River levels were not re-checked in this pass; see the Rivers page for the latest.

bulletin5.advisory_ne: मंसिर १० देखि मंसिर १४ सम्म पाँचै दिन देशभर कुनै मौसम चेतावनी छैन; सबै हरियो।
bulletin5.advisory_en: No weather warning anywhere for all five days, Mangsir 10 to Mangsir 14 (26 to 30 Nov); all green.

bulletin5.map_note_en: DHM's 5-day warning maps are green (no warning) across the country on all five days, Mangsir 10 to Mangsir 14.

country.analysis_ne: हाल नेपालमा कुनै पनि मौसमी प्रणालीको उल्लेखनीय प्रभाव रहेको छैन ।
country.analysis_en: Currently, no significant weather system is influencing Nepal.
country.day_ne: कोशी प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी क्षेत्र, गण्डकी, लुम्बिनी, कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशका पहाडी क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ।
country.day_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi Province, and the Hilly regions of Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim Provinces, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas.
country.night_ne: कोशी प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ, बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। बिहानपख उपत्यका र खोँचहरूका साथै तराई भू-भागका केही स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ ।
country.night_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan and Hilly regions of Koshi Province, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Mist/fog is likely at some places in valleys and river basins, as well as in the Terai regions, during the early morning.
